lessons.lesson: Review every held position each run from its `stop` block, not by hand. For each qualitative invalidation clause (an exchange failure, a guidance cut, a rate move), say whether it has tripped and why; on a day with a dated macro print (CPI, payrolls, a Fed decision), do this for every rate- or macro-conditioned clause. Re-anchor stale stops through thesis_updates with a stop_price.

lessons.lesson: When the Market Analyst's same-day note contradicts the role a held position's thesis gives it (e.g. 'hedge for an equity drawdown' while he says bonds are falling with stocks), don't defend the hold with that role. Restate the role through thesis_updates or name the position as a sell candidate.
